plain_english: This contract is the complete and final agreement between you and the client; anything said before or outside the written document does not count unless it is added in writing and signed by both parties.
what_it_means_for_you: You can only rely on what is written here, not on any earlier promises or informal chats.
risk_reasons: The clause simply limits the parties to the written contract, which is standard and does not create new obligations or penalties.
questions_to_ask: If there were any verbal agreements or understandings, do we need them added to the contract?
How will future changes be documented to ensure they are enforceable?
evidence_quote: (a) This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the parties.
